what_it_does: Support teams managing high-performance computing (HPC) clusters and supercomputers are drowning in technical support tickets as the user base expands and systems grow more complex. Manually reviewing thousands of tickets to write up frequently-asked questions is not practical. This paper proposes an automated pipeline that feeds support tickets to a large language model to solve the problem: first, it filters tickets to keep only recent and frequent ones, then summarizes each one into plain language; next, it groups similar summaries into clusters using semantic similarity (finding summaries that mean roughly the same thing); finally, it feeds those clusters to an LLM to generate polished FAQ entries that cover the common issues. Human experts then review the results to ensure quality.
